  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM

  c.customer_state = 'SP'
GROUP BY

  SELECT DISTINCT
    g.geolocation_state AS geo_state,
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_state
  FROM geolocation g
  JOIN customers c
    ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    geo_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN customer_state = geo_state THEN customer_id END) AS matched_customers

  geo_state,
  CAST(matched_customers AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(total_customers, 0) AS match_ratio,
